items.source: PropertyValueProvider for CassandraPersistentProperty. This PropertyValueProvider allows querying whether the source contains a data source for CassandraPersistentProperty like a field or a column.
items.translation: PropertyValueProvider 用于 CassandraPersistentProperty。此 PropertyValueProvider 允许查询源对象是否包含针对 CassandraPersistentProperty（如字段或列）的数据源。
